2608.21825.title: VisAdj: Learning Adjacency Matrices from Node-Link Images
2608.21825.paper_summary: Learning adjacency matrices from node-link images is a fundamental problem for recovering structured graph information from visual observations. Existing methods typically rely on fixed KNN-based heuristics for candidate edge selection and fail to capture dependencies among edges. To overcome these limitations, we propose VisAdj, a new framework for topology-aware adjacency prediction. VisAdj introduces an attention-sparse neighbor sampler to adaptively select a high-recall set of candidate node pairs and performs joint edge inference using a line-graph transformer that treats candidate edges as tokens and explicitly models dependencies among incident edges. Extensive experiments on synthetic graphs, road networks, and vessel images demonstrate that VisAdj consistently outperforms existing baselines by clear margins.
2608.21825.paper_summary_zh: 從節點連結圖學習鄰接矩陣是從視覺觀察中恢復結構化圖信息的基本問題。現有方法通常依賴於固定的基於 KNN 的啟發式方法來選擇候選邊，並未能捕捉邊之間的依賴關係。為了克服這些限制，我們提出了 VisAdj，一個新的拓撲感知鄰接預測框架。VisAdj 引入了一種注意力稀疏鄰居採樣器，能夠自適應地選擇高召回率的候選節點對集合，並使用線圖Transformer進行聯合邊推斷，將候選邊視為標記，並明確建模相鄰邊之間的依賴關係。在合成圖、道路網絡和船隻圖像上的廣泛實驗表明，VisAdj 在性能上始終明顯超越現有基準。
2608.21825.author: Jiahao Xie et.al.
